title: Avoiding possibility of duplicate index names in IndexLifecycleServiceTests.testExceptionStillProcessesOtherIndices

timeline.message: Avoiding possibility of duplicate index names in IndexLifecycleServiceTests.testExceptionStillProcessesOtherIndices
timeline.author: Keith Massey

timeline.body:
With certain seeds, two indexes in the test can have the same name, which causes test failures.
Closes #114530
I guess it doesn't matter if the UUIDs clash? I'm half wondering whether it's worth doing the same thing for that argument as well... Up to you whether you think it's worthwhile.

reply.body: I initially thought the same, but we actually never use the uuid. I'm not really sure why we bother creating an Index object.
